cues: Epithelial cells that specialise for secretion sink into the tissue below and form glands.
A single goblet cell is a unicellular gland; many cells together make a multicellular gland.
Exocrine glands release through a duct; endocrine glands have no duct and release hormones into the blood.
And there are three ways a cell can let go of its secretion.
text: Epithelial cells that specialise for secretion sink into the tissue below and form glands. A single goblet cell is a unicellular gland; many cells together make a multicellular gland. Exocrine glands release through a duct; endocrine glands have no duct and release hormones into the blood. And there are three ways a cell can let go of its secretion.
